name: RFS Discounts with Gravity Forms for Woocommerce
author: Rafal Puczel of RFS WP

sections.description:
Documentation / User Guide | Support | Home Page

This plugins is an add-on for Gravity Forms. Requires Gravity Form plugin to work.

RFS Discounts with Gravity Forms for Woocommerce plugin adds a functionality to Gravity Forms that let you create Woocommerce discount coupons for your customers once they’ve submitted a form on your website. It’s a great way to boost your sales or attract new customers.

FEATURES

  • Single page form support
  • Multi-page form support.
  • Display discount code in form confirmation
  • Use existing Woocommerce coupon
  • Unlimited plugin updates
  • Plugin support

DEVELOPER OPTIONS

The addon includes custom hooks and filters. You can find the details in plugin Documentation

[+] PREMIUM FEATURES

  • Apply the discount code to shopping cart
  • Send discount code via email
  • Create / generate new coupon automatically
  • Custom email subject
  • Custom email from address
  • Custom email message
  • Fields merge tags support for more personalized message. Lets you include other form field values, like Name to be included in the email message.
  • Premium support (6-months included)

TRANSLATION READY

Do you speak another language? Want to contribute in a meaningful way to our plugin? Contact us if you’d like to help translating the plugin into your language.

SUPPORT

Having issues with the plugin? Contact us through the website.

Source Code

Unminified JavaScript and CSS source files are included in the /src/ directory of this plugin.
Unminified source code for JavaScript and CSS of select2 library is available at: https://github.com/select2/select2
sections.installation: Visit our plugin documentation for detailed instruction.
sections.faq:
1. How to install the plugin?

Visit our plugin documentation for detailed instruction.

2. Does it require the Gravity Forms plugin?

Yes, it does. This is an add-on plugin for Gravity Forms and will not work on its own.

3. Is the plugin compatible with WordPress Multisite?

Yes, it is.
